name: Darkvision
summary: See in dim light as if bright; darkness as dim (usually 60 ft.).
description: You can see in dim light within a stated range (commonly 60 feet) as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
notes: Exact range varies by ancestry (e.g. drow often 120 ft.).
